name: codex-plugin
description: Open a local PDF and keep its content and annotations current in the hosting Codex task.

interface.shortDescription: Review a local PDF with live task context.
interface.longDescription: Launches one explicitly referenced local PDF in the desktop built-in browser, then uses packaged lifecycle hooks to provide task-scoped PDF and annotation context on every prompt.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open this local PDF in PDF Proofreader.
